candidate: NVFP4 routed FFN experts for Nemotron, using the unchanged deployed CUDA backend
scope: Pre-conversion operator screen for all 80 routed expert tensors in the 88 target blocks. Keep shared experts, latent projections, router, attention/SSM, output and appended MTP weights unchanged.
inventory: Read both original GGUF shards. Require 40 Q4_K up tensors [1024,2688,512] and 40 IQ4_NL down tensors [2688,1024,512].

graphs.up: MUL_MAT_ID with broadcast activation, followed by RELU and SQR
graphs.down: MUL_MAT_ID with per-expert activation, followed by multiplication by expert weights
graphs.repeat: Repeat the complete graph with the already-published benchmark fix, not only its terminal activation or multiplication.
graphs.model_scope_limit: Does not include routing-score computation, expert summation, shared experts, latent projections or full-model inference.

patterns: one quarter spread and three quarters concentrated

correctness.reference: Existing CPU backend on the same quantized tensors and complete local graphs
correctness.shapes: Both actual matrix orientations at n=1,4,512 with all three route patterns
correctness.tolerances: Existing test_mul_mat_id limits: 5e-4 normally, 2e-2 for native Blackwell FP4 activations. No relaxation.
correctness.limit: The reduced expert count bounds reference initialization cost; the performance fixtures use all 512 experts.

performance.weights: Equal weight across both orientations and three routes; each orientation occurs in 40 target layers.

promotion: Only a survivor warrants original-weight provenance checks, separate conversion, independent precision/quality gates and matched full-model timing. No deployment from operator results.
stop: Do not alter shapes, routing, activation precision, thresholds or tensor subsets after a weak result.
attribution: Existing upstream NVFP4 kernels; local model-applicability and measurement work, not a new kernel.
